Follow the team rules in AGENTS.md at the repository root. In short: always `git pull` before `git push`; work only in
your own `approaches/experiments/<name>/`; benchmark with `approaches/benchmarking/bench.py` and report page F2,
clause F2 and regulation F2 for every result; go through the overfitting checklist in AGENTS.md and keep `risk.json`
honest (never use `expected.json` outside the benchmark); enable the hooks (`git config core.hooksPath .githooks`) so
every commit rebuilds the dashboard; never commit secrets. Setup: CONTRIBUTING.md.
